entries.description: enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint (default: disabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_METRICS)
entries.notes: Flag gates the Prometheus /metrics endpoint on both servers, default disabled, same env binding. GET /metrics is now always mounted and answers b10621's own 501 diagnostic when the flag is off, and the exported body opens with the llamacpp: metric families (#1440); mlxcel's additional mlxcel_ families and --metrics-port secondary listener are additive surfaces b10621 does not have.

entries.description: enable changing global properties via POST /props (default: disabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_PROPS)
entries.notes: Since #1440 the flag has b10621's exact semantics: GET /props is always mounted and --props gates POST /props, which acknowledges {"success": true} without reading the body, exactly upstream's (empty) handler. The earlier drift (flag gated GET, no POST existed) is resolved.

entries.description: number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep (default: -1; -1 = disabled)
path to save slot kv cache (default: disabled)
entries.notes: Accepted on both binaries and gating POST /slots/:id_slot exactly as b10621 does (#1440). Deferred, not supported, because the persisted state is the slot's token stream plus model/tokenizer identity rather than the KV cache the flag's help text names; see the POST /slots/:id_slot entry for the recorded divergence.
divergence: The save file carries the slot's token stream and identity, not its KV cache; a restore therefore re-prefills (or adopts from the server's own prompt cache) on the next request instead of reading KV state from disk (#1440).

entries.description: expose slots monitoring endpoint (default: enabled) (env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_SLOTS)
entries.notes: Spelling and default (enabled) match, and LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_SLOTS is honored at runtime (env_fallback_endpoint_slots, src/server/cli_input.rs) rather than as a clap env attribute, so --slots / --no-slots keep precedence over it. Since #1440 the route is always mounted and a disabled endpoint answers b10621's 501 diagnostic instead of a 404; response-field parity is tracked on the GET /slots route entry.

Mounted unconditionally with b10621's 501 diagnostic when --metrics is off, and the body exports the b10621 llamacpp: counter and gauge families name-for-name with the Process-Start-Time-Unix header and between-scrape throughput-gauge averaging (#1440). The spec_decode_* counters accumulate from the DFlash burst and MTP tick-slice drivers; the opt-in B>1 batched burst arms (MLXCEL_ENABLE_MTP_BATCH=1) and the legacy MTP_TICK_SLICE=0 burst do not feed them yet, and speculative decoding is off by default so the shipped default exports the same zeros b10621 does. The per-position spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos_total block is omitted while empty, as upstream omits it. mlxcel's additional mlxcel_ families are additive.

Since #1440 the route is mounted unconditionally like b10621 and reports the full upstream key set: default_generation_settings as {params, n_ctx}, total_slots, model identity (alias/ftype/path), modalities, media_marker, the three endpoint toggles, ui and ui_settings, chat_template and chat_template_caps (the nine jinja::caps keys), bos/eos tokens, build_info, is_sleeping and cors_proxy_enabled, plus mlxcel extension keys (kv_cache_mode, kv_bits, speculative, geometry, capabilities) that b10621 clients ignore. Deferred for the params key-set divergence below.
divergence: default_generation_settings.params reports the resolved defaults mlxcel actually acts on under upstream's key names; b10621 task_params keys with no mlxcel analogue (mirostat family, dynatemp, n_keep/n_discard, min_keep, samplers, chat_format, reasoning placement, speculative.types, lora) are omitted rather than invented, the #1441 generation_settings precedent (#1440).
media_marker is null: mlxcel takes media as content parts and has no textual marker where b10621 reports mtmd's <__media__> (#1440).

entries.notes: Since #1440 the response is b10621's slot-object shape from a real per-request slot registry: id, n_ctx, speculative, is_processing, and for a slot that has carried a task its id_task, n_prompt_tokens, n_prompt_tokens_processed, n_prompt_tokens_cache, params, and the next_token progress block, with prompt/generated redacted unless LLAMA_SERVER_SLOTS_DEBUG is set, exactly upstream's slots_debug gate. fail_on_no_slot answers the 503 no-slot envelope. Deferred for the params key-set divergence below.
divergence: The slot params block reports the settings mlxcel actually resolves; b10621 task_params keys with no mlxcel analogue are omitted rather than invented, the same divergence GET /props records (#1440).
A request admitted while every slot is busy runs from the scheduler queue without a slot number and binds a slot when one frees; b10621 defers the whole task until a slot is assigned (#1440).

entries.notes: Gated by --props with b10621's 501 diagnostic when off; when on it acknowledges {"success": true} without reading the body, which is exactly upstream's handler (its body is empty apart from the acknowledgement).

Save, restore and erase are served behind --slot-save-path with b10621's response schemas (n_saved/n_written, n_restored/n_read, n_erased, timings), its stoi slot-id parsing, its Invalid slot ID / Invalid action / Invalid filename refusals with fs_validate_filename ported rule for rule, atomic writes, canonical-path confinement that refuses symlink escapes, and model/tokenizer identity binding on restore (#1440).
divergence: The save file carries the slot's token stream plus model/tokenizer identity, not its KV cache; restore rehydrates tokens and the next request re-prefills (or adopts from the server's own prompt cache) instead of reading KV state from disk (#1440).
An action addressed to a slot that is processing answers 503 unavailable_error; b10621 defers the action until the slot frees and then performs it (#1440).
